note: Attacker-controlled markdown text enters block-level parsing.
Line is dispatched to fenced-code parsing when the fenced-code extension is enabled.

code: w = parse_codefence(doc, data, i, &lang, &width, &chr, flags, attr);
note: First line length (excluding newline) is passed as the fence-detection size.

code: i = w = is_codefence(data, size, width, chr);
note: Code-fence detection runs on the raw line slice with its exact length.
data[i] is read before the bounds check; when the line is three spaces, i == size == 3 and data[3] is one byte past the slice.
Bounds check is evaluated only after the out-of-bounds read has already occurred.
